description: Reddit, Inc.'s mission is to empower communities and make their knowledge accessible to everyone, and it built Reddit with the belief that communities unlock the power of human creativity and create a sense of belonging and empowerment for their members, with its over 100,000 active communities having channeled the power of human creativity to grow Reddit since its founding, and it believes the world needs community more than ever and that this represents its greatest opportunity to further enrich the lives of everyone in the world. Reddit is a global, digital city where anyone in the world can join a community to learn from one another, engage in authentic conversations, explore passions, research new hobbies, exchange goods and services, create new communities and experiences, share a few laughs, and find belonging, and it turned 20 in 2025, two decades of building a user-powered platform where users bring their honest selves and connect over the topics they care most about.
